text:
Elliot: hey all, first day here. received my 13" MBP and trying to finish setup. Company Portal shows 'Enrollment pending' and when I tried enabling FileVault it errored with code 4922. macOS 13.6.4. I also need to install Rosetta & brew. Who can open a short admin window?

IT: welcome Elliot! Try signing out/in of Company Portal first. If that doesn't help, paste outputs of `profiles status -type enrollment` and `fdesetup status`. We typically push a 60-minute admin token.

Elliot: outputs: `profiles: No configuration profiles installed.` and `fdesetup status: FileVault is Off`. UI shows FileVault enabling.

ops-amy: I can trigger the enrollment and grant a 60-minute admin token. We don't grant permanent admin. Shall I push now?

Elliot: yes please, that would be great.

ops-amy: pushing enrollment + admin now. Expect a macOS prompt from Company Portal. After accepting, run:
`softwareupdate --install-rosetta --agree-to-license`
and then the Homebrew installer. Run `sudo -v` to check.

MDM Bot: Enrollment re-triggered by ops-amy for serial ending in ZYX987. Admin token active for 60 minutes.

ops-amy: admin looks active on our side. If FileVault still conflicts after this we'll escalate to imaging or Apple support.

Elliot: got the prompt, Rosetta & brew installed, Docker started. `fdesetup status` now says FileVault is On. Rebooting to be safe. Thanks!

DevX: FYI you may see Spotlight reindexing and heavier disk activity while encryption finishes. If any brew packages need preapproval ping #devx.
resolution: enrollment re-triggered, 60-minute admin granted, Rosetta/Homebrew installed, FileVault ended up On after re-trigger, user rebooted
